stories.title: NPCI revises UPI MDR framework
stories.body: 0.4% charge on merchant (P2M) UPI transactions above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300 per transaction.

stories.title: Cabinet raises EPFO wage ceiling ₹15,000 → ₹25,000
stories.body: EPS pension contribution cap up to ₹2,080/month; effective 17 Sept 2026.

stories.title: Indian Oil approves ₹2,449 cr Kochi–Thoothukudi gas pipeline
stories.body: 424.65 km natural gas pipeline.

stories.title: HAL hands over LCA Tejas FOC trainers, HTT-40 "Ankur" trainers & Dhruv NG helicopters
stories.body: Dhruv NG is India's first indigenous civil helicopter with AS-4 compliance.

stories.title: Adani Power's 3,200 MW ultra-supercritical plant in Dhubri (Assam)
stories.body: ₹48,000 crore investment; Northeast's largest power asset.

stories.title: Asia's first Telecom Manufacturing Zone in Gwalior (MP)
stories.body: ~₹5,500 crore investment, 18,000+ jobs; DoT–MP MoU signed July 2026.

stories.title: India aims to be world's No. 1 silk producer by 2028-29
stories.body: output rose 26,000 MT (2014) → 42,000 MT now; Karnataka leads.

stories.title: FCRA (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026
stories.body: assets from foreign funds vest in a government-appointed authority if FCRA registration is cancelled/lapses; 22,496 NGO registrations cancelled since 2015.

stories.title: LPG biometric authentication mandatory from 1 Oct 2026
stories.body: 27.43 crore consumers (89.9%) already verified; unverified pay market price.

stories.title: IAF to host 2nd edition of Tarang Shakti
stories.body: multinational air exercise at Jodhpur, 26 Sept–12 Oct 2026.

stories.title: Exercise Nomadic Elephant 18th edition begins
stories.body: India–Mongolia joint military exercise at Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand.

stories.title: SLINEX-26
stories.body: 13th India–Sri Lanka bilateral naval exercise at Visakhapatnam; INS Kavaratti & INS Jyoti participated.

stories.title: India's first indigenous long-range OWA drone 'KAL' tested at Pokhran
stories.body: 1,000 km range, 7–8 hr endurance, 50 kg payload.

stories.title: WMO State of Global Water Resources 2025
stories.body: 34% of groundwater stations below normal; persistent depletion in parts of India (2022–25).

stories.title: 20th Asian Games opened in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
stories.body: theme 'Harmonic Heart Beat'; flag-bearers Manu Bhaker & Pawan Sehrawat; teqball debut.

stories.title: Savita Punia becomes India's most-capped women's hockey player
stories.body: 321 senior caps (surpassed Vandana Katariya's 320); ₹10 lakh Hockey India reward.

stories.title: Premier Energies commissions India's largest solar cell facility
stories.body: 7 GW N-type TOPCon plant at Naidupeta, Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: India makes first farm-level soil carbon payments
stories.body: 2,550 Punjab/Haryana farmers receive ₹2.9+ cr under the 'Aadi' programme (~50,000 verified carbon credits).

stories.title: Deep-sea mining push
stories.body: India holds 3 ISA exploration contracts (~95,000 sq km); MATSYA-6000 human submersible under the Deep Ocean Mission.

stories.title: New orchid 'Gastrodia keyiensis' discovered in Arunachal Pradesh
stories.body: leafless "Ghost Flower" along the Keyi River; paper in Phytotaxa (9 Sept 2026).

stories.title: New cat species 'Leopardus tilcayo' identified in Bolivia
stories.body: first new living feline species described in over 100 years.

one_liners: UPI MDR: 0.4% above ₹2,000 (cap ₹300) — NPCI.
EPFO wage ceiling: ₹15,000 → ₹25,000; EPS cap ₹2,080/month.
Moody's FY27 GDP forecast: 7% (Baa3, stable).
Gender Gap Index 2026: India 131/145 (WEF).
Electric Mobility Index 2025 topper: Delhi (84) — NITI Aayog.
Oscars 2027 Indian entry: Gondhal (Marathi).
Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2024: Anant Nag.
Asian Games 2026 host: Aichi-Nagoya, Japan; theme 'Harmonic Heart Beat'.
Most-capped Indian women's hockey player: Savita Punia (321).
Tarang Shakti 2nd edition: Jodhpur, 26 Sept–12 Oct 2026.
Nomadic Elephant: India–Mongolia, 18th edition, Pithoragarh.
SLINEX-26: India–Sri Lanka, 13th edition, Visakhapatnam.
OWA drone 'KAL': 1,000 km range, tested at Pokhran.
MDL shipbuilding cluster: ₹27,000 cr, Dighi (Raigad).
IOCL gas pipeline: ₹2,449 cr, Kochi–Thoothukudi (424.65 km).
ONGC gas discovery: Mahanadi offshore basin.
FASTag portability: OneTag, Rajmargyatra app, 6-month cooling.
LPG biometric auth mandatory: 1 Oct 2026.
Births & Deaths (Amendment) Act, 2026 effective: 1 Oct 2026.
FCRA cancellations since 2015: 22,496; active NGOs: 14,466.
Telecom Manufacturing Zone: Gwalior, ~₹5,500 cr, 18,000+ jobs.
Soil carbon payments: ₹2.9+ cr to 2,550 farmers ('Aadi' programme).
Ghost Flower orchid: Gastrodia keyiensis, Arunachal Pradesh.
New feline species: Leopardus tilcayo, Bolivia.
